title: The ring lies down into the stack · frame 4
prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLES:
— the previous frame of this storyboard. BASE IMAGE: edit it as instructed; everything the instruction does not change stays exactly as it is.
— a gold emblem on black: an open circle broken at the upper right, crossed by a level bar and a steep slanted bar that meet in a small stepped block. OBJECT REFERENCE: this is the Thoughtform brand mark. Reproduce its shape exactly, engraved into the top face of the central gold dot plate, lying flat on the plate and foreshortened with it.

FRAME 4 OF 4, THE DEEP VIEW. Edit the base image. Keep exactly: the camera, the near-black ground, the palette (bone white, muted gold, sage green only), the hairline line weight, the square-dot language of the plates, and the gold central plate with the engraved Thoughtform mark in the same place and size. No words or letters anywhere. Change one thing: the ghost arcs are gone and the three plates pull apart vertically, far apart, joined by thin dotted vertical lines; from the top plate thin dotted lines run out to the left edge, from the bottom plate thin dotted lines run out to the right edge, each ending in a small empty square outline. Sparse and calm: this is the simplest frame.
